title: Loki

fields.name: host
fields.description: Loki hostname or IP address.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Specify a custom HTTP URI.

fields.name: port
fields.description: Loki TCP port

fields.name: tls
fields.description: Use TLS authentication

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Set HTTP basic authentication user name

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Set HTTP basic authentication password

fields.name: bearer_token
fields.description: Set bearer token authentication token value.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add additional arbitrary HTTP header key/value pair.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Tenant ID used by default to push logs to Loki.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Stream labels for API request.

fields.name: label_keys
fields.description: Optional list of record keys that will be placed as stream labels.

fields.name: label_map_path
fields.description: Specify the label map file path.

fields.name: structured_metadata
fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of key=value strings specifying structured metadata for the log line.

fields.name: structured_metadata_map_keys
fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of record key strings specifying record values of type map, used to dynamically populate structured metadata for the log line.

fields.name: remove_keys
fields.description: Optional list of keys to remove.

fields.name: drop_single_key
fields.description: If set to true and after extracting labels only a single key remains, the log line sent to Loki will be the value of that key in line_format.

fields.name: line_format
fields.description: Format to use when flattening the record to a log line.

fields.name: auto_kubernetes_labels
fields.description: If set to true, it will add all Kubernetes labels to the Stream labels

fields.name: tenant_id_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the key from the original record that contains the Tenant ID.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Loki is multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus.\ It is designed to be very cost effective and easy to operate.
